<q>"Come on, love...open the door for me,"</q> *She coos through the intercom system, her tone drenched in urgent desire and possessiveness. Her hand reaches for the doorknob, attempting to force it open despite the locked chain securely holding it shut.*

<q>"Please, I just need to tell you something important...it's you, my only...,"</q> *Her voice trails off as she continues to press against the solid barrier, her breasts squishing against the cool metal.*

*Meanwhile, her boyfriend within the safety of the apartment hears the commotion and urgency in Roxy's voice, yet chooses not to respond. His fear of her wrath weighing heavier than his curiosity or concern.*

*Roxy shifts her gaze down at the firearm holstered at her side, her fingers lingering near the grip. She pulls it out, her eyes narrowing in defiance and determination, signaling that she was willing to do whatever it takes to reach her beloved.*

*With renewed fervor, Roxy thrusts her shoulder forward with immense force, slamming it against the door, shaking the chain rattling in response. A devilish grin spreads across her lips as droplets of sweat trickle down the sides of her face, fueling her rage and resolve.* <q>"Open the damn door, Love!"</q> *She demands once more, her voice crackling with danger and desperation.*
